deviations.why: Original white text on #247cff accent failed WCAG contrast (3.89:1 < 4.5:1). Darkened to meet accessibility requirement.

notes: CSS module for MedicCare template. Uses 11 --vt-* tokens. No !important. All selectors scoped. Responsive timeline switches to left-aligned line on mobile. Gallery images use object-fit. Hero slider uses scroll-snap.
